articles.title: Poland-based Liftero will provide chemical propulsion for Indian firm OrbitAID’s in-orbit servicing mission
articles.summary:
WARSAW — Polish chemical propulsion startup Liftero has signed a deal with India’s commercial in-orbit servicing specialist OrbitAID where Liftero will supply green chemical propulsion for OrbitAID’s in-orbit servicing spacecraft.  Under the contract, Liftero will supply two multi-thruster BOOSTER configurations for an upcoming OrbitAID mission expected in the fourth quarter of 2026. articles.title: ENPULSION Secures €22.5 Million to Expand US Market Presence
articles.summary:
Austrian space propulsion company ENPULSION has secured €22.5 million in new growth funding to expand its footprint in the US. Founded in 2016, ENPULSION provides electric propulsion systems for micro, nano, and small satellites.
